answer: A new identity serves a probation of 10 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the mesa queue naming the reef that holds the sponsor's bond. As a result, every alias costs 10 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the vine record shows exactly who is still on probation. That is 8 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
